1# ORION Part 1 - pose fusion service23Ingests the evaluation sensor log and publishes a contract pose stream at 48 Hz.45## Reproduce67Python 3.12+, Windows PowerShell.89```powershell10python -m venv .venv11.\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps112pip install -r requirements.txt1314python -m unittest discover -s tests -v1516python scripts\run.py --log data\orion-eval-log.json --config configs\orion-v1.json --out output\eval --output-name orion-eval-output.jsonl17```1819Config: `configs/orion-v1.json`.2021The submitted eval stream is `../eval/orion-eval-output.jsonl` from one pass of that command.22

1{2 "contract": "FIXTURE-orion-pose-contract",3 "version": 2,4 "publish_rate_hz_min": 24,5 "source_world": "ENU right-handed meters; quaternion [w,x,y,z] body->world; monotonic source seconds",6 "target_frame_conventions": {7 "handedness": "left",8 "units": "centimeters",9 "axes": "X=East, Y=Up, Z=North (Y-up)",10 "quaternion_storage": "[x, y, z, w] (w last)",11 "transform_kind": "point transform",12 "origin": "translated so t=0 position is the origin"13 },14 "output_stream_fields": {15 "seq": "int, strictly increasing",16 "t_source": "float s, monotonic",17 "pos_target": "[x,y,z] in the TARGET frame/units you compose from target_frame_conventions",18 "quat_target": "quaternion in the TARGET storage order",19 "confidence": "0..1",20 "source_age_s": "now - t_captured",21 "state": "tracking | degraded | lost"22 },23 "rules": [24 "Output >= 24 Hz. pose_source drifts and is biased and has dropouts; hold accuracy by fusing IMU (bounded by the low-rate RTK), not by republishing pose_source or RTK.",25 "Transform your pose into the TARGET frame defined by target_frame_conventions (compose it yourself; no literal transform is given).",26 "During a dropout, publish state=degraded/lost with the LAST good pose HELD (or a disclosed decay) - never a fresh pose presented as tracking; source_age_s must grow.",27 "Reject invalid observations (duplicate / stale / out-of-order) with a reason."28 ],29 "submission": {30 "you_get": [31 "orion-dev-log.json (with orion-dev-selfcheck.json)",32 "orion-eval-log.json (RAW - run your service on it and submit the output)"33 ],34 "you_submit": [35 "your output stream on the EVAL log (orion-eval-output.jsonl, one JSON object per line with the output_stream_fields)",36 "your rejected-observation log {seq, reason}",37 "a timestamped latency trace",38 "your service code + config",39 "the recording + AI session log"40 ]41 }42}

1"""ORION replay pose service: IMU / pose_source / RTK fusion."""23__version__ = "1.0.0"4

1"""Error-state EKF with innovation-adaptive measurement noise.23IMU mechanization is the process model. Pose and RTK are measurements whose4R is estimated online from innovations (Mehra IAE + NIS inflation). Nothing5here is fitted to keyframes.67Pose position is modelled as z = p + bp. That measurement updates both p and8bp; RTK observes p alone so the pair is jointly observable. Attitude and9finite-difference velocity are separate channels so each source can earn a10different R from its own innovations.11"""1213from __future__ import annotations1415from dataclasses import dataclass16from typing import Optional1718import numpy as np1920from orion.mathutil import (21 quat_error_vec,22 quat_from_delta_theta,23 quat_mul,24 quat_normalize,25 quat_to_R,26 skew,27)2829N = 1830I3 = np.eye(3)31I18 = np.eye(N)32# χ² 0.95, 3 dof - NIS gate for one 3-vector update, not a data prior33_CHI2_3_95 = 7.81534_CHI2_1_95 = 3.841353637@dataclass38class AdaptChannel:39 """Per-source uncertainty from the filter's own innovations.4041 Seed R is a generic scale, not fitted to this log. Pose channels:42 - NIS vs that seed flags *this sample* as an outlier (Huber on R)43 - a slow EMA of NIS flags overconfident P (inflate P in the observed44 subspace so a healthy sensor can pull again)4546 RTK also keeps a live R from *increment* residuals (GNSS epoch minus47 IMU epoch). That is GNSS white noise, not IMU coast, so R does not48 swallow a pose dropout and K does not go to 1 on every 5 Hz sample.49 """5051 dim: int52 var_seed: float53 tau_s: float = 1.054 ema_nis: float = 3.055 t: Optional[float] = None56 var_live: float = 0.057 var_min: float = 0.058 var_max: float = 0.059 var_axis: np.ndarray | None = None6061 def __post_init__(self) -> None:62 if self.var_live <= 0.0:63 self.var_live = self.var_seed64 if self.var_min <= 0.0:65 self.var_min = self.var_seed * 0.0166 if self.var_max <= 0.0:67 self.var_max = self.var_seed * 100.068 if self.var_axis is None:69 self.var_axis = np.full(self.dim, self.var_live, dtype=float)7071 def nis_alpha(self, t: Optional[float]) -> float:72 if self.t is None or t is None:73 a = 0.174 else:75 dt = max(float(t) - float(self.t), 1e-6)76 a = float(np.clip(1.0 - np.exp(-dt / self.tau_s), 0.02, 0.2))77 if t is not None:78 self.t = float(t)79 return a8081 def observe_increment(self, nu: np.ndarray, t: Optional[float]) -> None:82 """IAE on GNSS-minus-IMU *increments* over one measurement epoch.8384 If the increment NIS is large vs current R, that is IMU/process, not85 GNSS: leave that axis's R alone so a pose dropout does not train R86 up to metres. 1"""Compose the contract target frame from source ENU.23Source: right-handed ENU metres, body-to-world quat [w, x, y, z].4Target: left-handed centimetres, X=East, Y=Up, Z=North, quat [x, y, z, w].56Axis permutation T swaps North and Up (Y <-> Z). T is an involution (T @ T = I)7with det(T) = -1. Positions use the point map p_t = 100 * T @ (p - p0).8Orientation uses the change-of-basis R_t = T @ R_enu @ T so identity stays9identity and a yaw about world-up stays a yaw about world-up.10"""1112from __future__ import annotations1314import numpy as np1516from orion.mathutil import R_to_quat, quat_to_R1718# Source ENU (E, N, U) -> target (E, U, N)19T = np.array(20 [21 [1.0, 0.0, 0.0],22 [0.0, 0.0, 1.0],23 [0.0, 1.0, 0.0],24 ],25 dtype=float,26)2728CM_PER_M = 100.0293031def position_enu_to_target(p_enu: np.ndarray, origin_enu: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:32 return (T @ (np.asarray(p_enu, dtype=float) - np.asarray(origin_enu, dtype=float))) * CM_PER_M333435def quat_enu_wxyz_to_target_xyzw(q_wxyz: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:36 R_enu = quat_to_R(q_wxyz)37 R_tgt = T @ R_enu @ T38 q_wxyz_t = R_to_quat(R_tgt)39 return np.array([q_wxyz_t[1], q_wxyz_t[2], q_wxyz_t[3], q_wxyz_t[0]], dtype=float)404142def transform_pose(43 p_enu: np.ndarray, q_wxyz: np.ndarray, origin_enu: np.ndarray44) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:45 return position_enu_to_target(p_enu, origin_enu), quat_enu_wxyz_to_target_xyzw(q_wxyz)46

1"""Load ORION sensor logs and build a time-ordered event list."""23from __future__ import annotations45import json6from dataclasses import dataclass, field7from pathlib import Path8from typing import Any, Literal910Kind = Literal["imu", "pose", "rtk"]11KIND_ORDER = {"imu": 0, "pose": 1, "rtk": 2}121314@dataclass(frozen=True)15class Event:16 t: float17 kind: Kind18 payload: dict[str, Any]19 order: int = field(compare=False)202122def load_log(path: str | Path) -> dict[str, Any]:23 return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))242526def iter_events(log: dict[str, Any]) -> list[Event]:27 streams = log["streams"]28 events: list[Event] = []29 n = 030 for rec in streams.get("imu", []):31 events.append(Event(t=float(rec["t"]), kind="imu", payload=rec, order=n))32 n += 133 for rec in streams.get("pose_source", []):34 events.append(35 Event(t=float(rec["t_source"]), kind="pose", payload=rec, order=n)36 )37 n += 138 for rec in streams.get("rtk", []):39 events.append(Event(t=float(rec["t"]), kind="rtk", payload=rec, order=n))40 n += 141 events.sort(key=lambda e: (e.t, KIND_ORDER[e.kind], e.order))42 return events434445def estimate_gravity_magnitude(log: dict[str, Any], window_s: float = 0.5) -> float:46 imu = log["streams"]["imu"]47 if not imu:48 return 9.8066549 t0 = float(imu[0]["t"])50 norms = []51 for rec in imu:52 if float(rec["t"]) - t0 > window_s:53 break54 a = rec["accel_m_s2"]55 norms.append((a[0] * a[0] + a[1] * a[1] + a[2] * a[2]) ** 0.5)56 if not norms:57 return 9.8066558 norms.sort()59 mag = norms[len(norms) // 2]60 if 9.4 < mag < 10.2:61 return float(mag)62 return 9.80665636465def log_time_span(log: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[float, float]:66 times: list[float] = []67 meta = log.get("meta") or {}68 streams = log["streams"]69 for rec in streams.get("imu", []):70 times.append(float(rec["t"]))71 for rec in streams.get("pose_source", []):72 times.append(float(rec["t_source"]))73 for rec in streams.get("rtk", []):74 times.append(float(rec["t"]))75 t0 = min(times)76 duration = float(meta.get("duration_s") or 0.0)77 t1 = t0 + duration if duration > 0 else max(times)78 return t0, t179

1"""Quaternion and SO(3) helpers. Hamilton convention, storage [w, x, y, z]."""23from __future__ import annotations45import numpy as np67_EPS = 1e-128910def skew(v: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:11 x, y, z = v12 return np.array(13 [[0.0, -z, y], [z, 0.0, -x], [-y, x, 0.0]],14 dtype=float,15 )161718def quat_normalize(q: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:19 q = np.asarray(q, dtype=float)20 n = np.linalg.norm(q)21 if n < _EPS:22 return np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0])23 q = q / n24 if q[0] < 0.0:25 q = -q26 return q272829def quat_mul(q1: np.ndarray, q2: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:30 w1, x1, y1, z1 = q131 w2, x2, y2, z2 = q232 return np.array(33 [34 w1 * w2 - x1 * x2 - y1 * y2 - z1 * z2,35 w1 * x2 + x1 * w2 + y1 * z2 - z1 * y2,36 w1 * y2 - x1 * z2 + y1 * w2 + z1 * x2,37 w1 * z2 + x1 * y2 - y1 * x2 + z1 * w2,38 ],39 dtype=float,40 )414243def quat_conj(q: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:44 return np.array([q[0], -q[1], -q[2], -q[3]], dtype=float)454647def quat_to_R(q: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:48 """Body-to-world rotation matrix from [w, x, y, z]."""49 w, x, y, z = quat_normalize(q)50 return np.array(51 [52 [1.0 - 2.0 * (y * y + z * z), 2.0 * (x * y - z * w), 2.0 * (x * z + y * w)],53 [2.0 * (x * y + z * w), 1.0 - 2.0 * (x * x + z * z), 2.0 * (y * z - x * w)],54 [2.0 * (x * z - y * w), 2.0 * (y * z + x * w), 1.0 - 2.0 * (x * x + y * y)],55 ],56 dtype=float,57 )585960def R_to_quat(R: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:61 """Shepperd's method; returns [w, x, y, z] with w >= 0."""62 R = np.asarray(R, dtype=float)63 t = float(np.trace(R))64 if t > 0.0:65 s = 0.5 / np.sqrt(t + 1.0)66 w = 0.25 / s67 x = (R[2, 1] - R[1, 2]) * s68 y = (R[0, 2] - R[2, 0]) * s69 z = (R[1, 0] - R[0, 1]) * s70 else:71 i = int(np.argmax([R[0, 0], R[1, 1], R[2, 2]]))72 if i == 0:73 s = 2.0 * np.sqrt(max(1e-12, 1.0 + R[0, 0] - R[1, 1] - R[2, 2]))74 w = (R[2, 1] - R[1, 2]) / s75 x = 0.25 * s76 y = (R[0, 1] + R[1, 0]) / s77 z = (R[0, 2] + R[2, 0]) / s78 elif i == 1:79 s = 2.0 * np.sqrt(max(1e-12, 1.0 + R[1, 1] - R[0, 0] - R[2, 2]))80 w = (R[0, 2] - R[2, 0]) / s81 x = (R[0, 1] + R[1, 0]) / s82 y = 0.25 * s83 z = (R[1, 2] + R[2, 1]) / s84 else:85 s = 2.0 * np.sqrt(max(1e-12, 1.0 + R[2, 2] - R[0, 0] - R[1, 1]))86 w = (R[1, 0] - R[0, 1]) / s87 x = (R[0, 2] + R[2, 0]) / s88 y = (R[1, 2] + R[2, 1]) / s89 z = 0.25 * s90 return quat_normalize(np.array([w, x, y, z], dtype=float))919293def quat_from_delta_theta(dtheta: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:94 """Small-angle body rotation [1, dtheta/2] with exact fallback."""95 angle = float(np.linalg.norm(dtheta))96 if angle < 1e-12:97 return quat_normalize(np.array([1.0, *(0.5 * dtheta)]))98 axis = dtheta / angle99 half = 0.5 * angle100 return np.array([np.cos(half), *(axis * np.sin(half))], dtype=float)101102103def quat_error_vec(q_nom: np.ndarray, q_meas: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:104 """Body-frame small-angle innovation: q_meas ≈ q_nom ⊗ [1, δθ/2]."""105 q_err = quat_mul(quat_conj(q_nom), q_meas)106 q_err = quat_normalize(q_err)107 vec = 2.0 * q_err[1:4]108 if q_err[0] < 0.0:109 vec = -vec110 return vec111112113def slerp(q0: np.ndarray, q1: np.ndarray, u: float) -> np.ndarray:114 q0 = quat_normalize(q0)115 q1 = quat_normalize(q1)116 dot = float(np.dot(q0, q1))117 if dot < 0.0:118 q1 = -q1119 dot = -dot120 if dot > 0.9995:121 return quat_normalize(q0 + u * (q1 - q0))122 theta = np.arccos(np.clip(dot, -1.0, 1.0))123 so = np.sin(theta)124 a = np.sin((1.0 - u) * theta) / so125 b = np.sin(u * theta) / so126 return quat_normalize(a * q0 + b * q1)127128129# Aliases used by EKF / frames130quat_from_delta_theta = quat_from_delta_theta131quat_to_R = quat_to_R132R_to_quat = R_to_quat133

1"""Measured report: rate, dropout age, latency percentiles."""23from __future__ import annotations45import json6from pathlib import Path7from typing import Any89import numpy as np101112def percentile(xs: list[float], p: float) -> float:13 if not xs:14 return float("nan")15 a = np.sort(np.asarray(xs, dtype=float))16 return float(np.percentile(a, p))171819def pose_gaps(log: dict[str, Any], min_gap_s: float = 0.05) -> list[tuple[float, float]]:20 ts = [float(r["t_source"]) for r in log["streams"]["pose_source"]]21 ts.sort()22 gaps = []23 for a, b in zip(ts, ts[1:]):24 if b - a > min_gap_s:25 gaps.append((a, b))26 return gaps272829def build_report(result: dict[str, Any], log: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:30 outs = result["outputs"]31 lat = result["latency"]32 t0, t1 = 1"""Post-run comparison against sparse keyframes. Never used inside the filter."""23from __future__ import annotations45import json6from pathlib import Path7from typing import Any89import numpy as np1011from orion.mathutil import quat_error_vec, slerp121314def load_selfcheck(path: str | Path) -> dict[str, Any]:15 return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))161718def interpolate_source(19 trace: list[dict[str, Any]], t: float20) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray] | None:21 if not trace:22 return None23 if t <= trace[0]["t"]:24 return np.array(trace[0]["pos_m"]), np.array(trace[0]["quat_wxyz"])25 if t >= trace[-1]["t"]:26 return np.array(trace[-1]["pos_m"]), np.array(trace[-1]["quat_wxyz"])27 lo, hi = 0, len(trace) - 128 while lo + 1 < hi:29 mid = (lo + hi) // 230 if trace[mid]["t"] <= t:31 lo = mid32 else:33 hi = mid34 a, b = trace[lo], trace[hi]35 span = b["t"] - a["t"]36 u = 0.0 if span <= 0 else (t - a["t"]) / span37 p = (1.0 - u) * np.array(a["pos_m"]) + u * np.array(b["pos_m"])38 q = slerp(np.array(a["quat_wxyz"]), np.array(b["quat_wxyz"]), u)39 return p, q404142def evaluate(trace: list[dict[str, Any]], selfcheck: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:43 bands = selfcheck["bands"]44 pos_err: list[float] = []45 ang_err: list[float] = []46 rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []47 for kf in selfcheck["keyframes"]:48 t = float(kf["t"])49 interp = interpolate_source(trace, t)50 if interp is None:51 continue52 p, q = interp53 p_true = np.array(kf["pos_m"], dtype=float)54 q_true = np.array(kf["quat_wxyz"], dtype=float)55 dp = float(np.linalg.norm(p - p_true))56 dth = float(np.linalg.norm(quat_error_vec(q_true, q)))57 ddeg = float(np.rad2deg(dth))58 pos_err.append(dp)59 ang_err.append(ddeg)60 rows.append({"t": t, "pos_err_m": dp, "ang_err_deg": ddeg})6162 def pct(xs: list[float], p: float) -> float:63 if not xs:64 return float("nan")65 s = sorted(xs)66 k = min(len(s) - 1, max(0, int(round((p / 100.0) * (len(s) - 1)))))67 return float(s[k])6869 pos_med = pct(pos_err, 50)70 pos_p95 = pct(pos_err, 95)71 ang_med = pct(ang_err, 50)72 ang_p95 = pct(ang_err, 95)73 passed = (74 pos_med <= bands["position_median_m"]75 and pos_p95 <= bands["position_p95_m"]76 and ang_med <= bands["orientation_median_deg"]77 and ang_p95 <= bands["orientation_p95_deg"]78 )79 return {80 "passed": passed,81 "n": len(rows),82 "position_median_m": pos_med,83 "position_p95_m": pos_p95,84 "orientation_median_deg": ang_med,85 "orientation_p95_deg": ang_p95,86 "bands": bands,87 "per_keyframe": rows,88 }89

1"""Causal reject rules for pose_source, IMU, and RTK."""23from __future__ import annotations45from dataclasses import dataclass, field6from typing import Any, Optional789@dataclass10class Rejection:11 seq: Any12 reason: str13 t_source: float14 stream: str151617@dataclass18class PoseValidator:19 future_capture_eps_s: float = 0.0520 stale_capture_s: float = 0.521 quat_norm_tol: float = 1e-322 last_seq: Optional[int] = None23 last_t: Optional[float] = None2425 def check(self, rec: dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[str]:26 seq = rec["seq"]27 t = float(rec["t_source"])28 cap = float(rec["t_captured"])29 q = rec["quat_wxyz"]30 conf = float(rec["confidence"])31 n = (q[0] * q[0] + q[1] * q[1] + q[2] * q[2] + q[3] * q[3]) ** 0.532 if abs(n - 1.0) > self.quat_norm_tol:33 return "non_unit_quat"34 if conf < 0.0 or conf > 1.0:35 return "confidence_oob"36 if cap > t + self.future_capture_eps_s:37 return "future_t_captured"38 if (t - cap) > self.stale_capture_s:39 return "stale_t_captured"40 if self.last_t is not None:41 if t < self.last_t - 1e-12:42 return "out_of_order_t_source"43 if abs(t - self.last_t) <= 1e-9:44 return "duplicate_t_source"45 if self.last_seq is not None:46 if seq == self.last_seq:47 return "duplicate_seq"48 if seq < self.last_seq:49 return "non_monotonic_seq"50 return None5152 def accept(self, rec: dict[str, Any]) -> None:53 self.last_seq = int(rec["seq"])54 self.last_t = float(rec["t_source"])555657@dataclass58class TimeValidator:59 stream: str60 last_t: Optional[float] = None6162 def check(self, t: float) -> Optional[str]:63 if self.last_t is not None and t <= self.last_t + 1e-12:64 return "out_of_order_t" if t < self.last_t - 1e-12 else "duplicate_t"65 return None6667 def accept(self, t: float) -> None:68 self.last_t = t697071@dataclass72class RejectLog:73 items: list[Rejection] = field(default_factory=list)7475 def add(self, seq: Any, reason: str, t_source: float, stream: str) -> None:76 self.items.append(77 Rejection(seq=seq, reason=reason, t_source=t_source, stream=stream)78 )7980 def as_dicts(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:81 out = []82 for r in self.items:83 row = {"seq": r.seq, "reason": r.reason, "t_source": r.t_source}84 if r.stream != "pose":85 row["stream"] = r.stream86 out.append(row)87 return out88

1"""Replay an ORION log and write contract outputs."""23from __future__ import annotations45import argparse6import sys7from pathlib import Path89ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]10if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:11 sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))1213from orion.ingest import load_log14from orion.report import build_report, write_report15from orion.selfcheck import evaluate, load_selfcheck16from orion.service import run_file171819def main() -> None:20 p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="ORION pose fusion replay")21 p.add_argument("--log", required=True, help="Sensor log JSON")22 p.add_argument("--config", default=str(ROOT / "configs" / "orion-v1.json"))23 p.add_argument("--out", required=True, help="Output directory")24 p.add_argument(25 "--output-name",26 default="orion-eval-output.jsonl",27 help="Pose stream filename inside --out",28 )29 p.add_argument(30 "--selfcheck",31 default=None,32 help="Optional sparse keyframes JSON (dev only; never fed to the filter)",33 )34 args = p.parse_args()3536 result = run_file(args.log, args.config, args.out, output_name=args.output_name)37 log = load_log(args.log)38 report = build_report(result, log)39 sc = None40 if args.selfcheck:41 sc = evaluate(result["source_trace"], load_selfcheck(args.selfcheck))42 print(43 f"selfcheck passed={sc['passed']} "44 f"pos med/p95={sc['position_median_m']:.4f}/{sc['position_p95_m']:.4f} m "45 f"ang med/p95={sc['orientation_median_deg']:.4f}/{sc['orientation_p95_deg']:.4f} deg"46 )47 write_report(Path(args.out) / "report.json", report, sc)48 print(f"wrote {len(result['outputs'])} poses to {args.out}/{args.output_name}")49 print(50 f"rate={report['publish_rate_hz']:.3f} Hz "51 f"latency_p50={report['latency_compute_ms_p50']:.3f} ms "52 f"latency_p95={report['latency_compute_ms_p95']:.3f} ms "53 f"rejected={report['n_rejected']}"54 )555657if __name__ == "__main__":58 main()59

1"""Stationary IMU predict should not walk away."""23from __future__ import annotations45import unittest67import numpy as np89from orion.ekf import EkfConfig, ErrorStateEKF101112class TestEkfStationary(unittest.TestCase):13 def test_hover_imu_stays_put(self):14 g = 9.8066515 cfg = EkfConfig(gravity=g)16 ekf = ErrorStateEKF(cfg)17 q = np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0])18 p0 = np.array([1.0, 2.0, 3.0])19 ekf.initialize(0.0, p0, q)20 gyro = np.zeros(3)21 accel = np.array([0.0, 0.0, g])22 dt = 0.00523 t = 0.024 for _ in range(200): # 1 second at 200 Hz25 t += dt26 ekf.ingest_imu(t, gyro, accel)27 np.testing.assert_allclose(ekf.p, p0, atol=0.02)28 np.testing.assert_allclose(ekf.v, np.zeros(3), atol=0.05)29 self.assertGreater(ekf.q[0], 0.99)3031 def test_rtk_pulls_position(self):32 cfg = EkfConfig()33 ekf = ErrorStateEKF(cfg)34 ekf.initialize(0.0, np.zeros(3), np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0]))35 z = np.array([1.0, -0.5, 0.2])36 t = 0.037 for _ in range(40):38 t += 0.239 ekf.predict_to(t)40 ekf.update_rtk(z, "rtk_fixed")41 np.testing.assert_allclose(ekf.p, z, atol=0.08)4243 def test_pose_bias_goes_to_bp_rtk_owns_p(self):44 ekf = ErrorStateEKF(EkfConfig())45 q = np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0])46 pose = np.array([0.3, 0.0, 0.0])47 rtk = np.zeros(3)48 ekf.initialize(0.0, pose, q)49 t = 0.050 for _ in range(80):51 t += 0.0552 ekf.predict_to(t)53 ekf.update_pose(pose, q, 1.0)54 if abs(t / 0.2 - round(t / 0.2)) < 1e-9:55 ekf.update_rtk(rtk, "rtk_fixed")56 np.testing.assert_allclose(ekf.p, rtk, atol=0.08)57 np.testing.assert_allclose(ekf.bp, pose - rtk, atol=0.08)5859 def test_pose_shape_moves_p_between_rtk(self):60 """After bp is learned, pose motion updates p; it is not only a 5 Hz RTK stair."""61 ekf = ErrorStateEKF(EkfConfig())62 q = np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0])63 bias = np.array([0.4, 0.0, 0.0])64 ekf.initialize(0.0, bias.copy(), q)65 t = 0.066 for _ in range(40):67 t += 0.0568 ekf.predict_to(t)69 ekf.update_pose(bias, q, 1.0)70 if abs(t / 0.2 - round(t / 0.2)) < 1e-9:71 ekf.update_rtk(np.zeros(3), "rtk_fixed")72 np.testing.assert_allclose(ekf.p, np.zeros(3), atol=0.1)73 np.testing.assert_allclose(ekf.bp, bias, atol=0.1)7475 # No RTK for 0.5 s. IMU is still (last predict is ZOH hover), so a76 # bp-only pose update would leave p near 0. Pose writing p should77 # follow the ramp; bp should stay the slow offset.78 t_motion = 0.079 for _ in range(10):80 t += 0.0581 t_motion += 0.0582 true_p = np.array([t_motion, 0.0, 0.0])83 ekf.predict_to(t)84 ekf.update_pose(true_p + bias, q, 1.0)85 self.assertGreater(float(ekf.p[0]), 0.2)86 self.assertLess(float(abs(ekf.p[0] - t_motion)), 0.25)87 np.testing.assert_allclose(ekf.bp, bias, atol=0.15)8889 def test_outlier_rtk_does_not_teleport(self):90 ekf = ErrorStateEKF(EkfConfig())91 q = np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0])92 ekf.initialize(0.0, np.zeros(3), q)93 t = 0.094 for _ in range(20):95 t += 0.296 ekf.predict_to(t)97 ekf.update_rtk(np.zeros(3), "rtk_fixed")98 p_before = ekf.p.copy()99 ekf.predict_to(t + 0.2)100 ekf.update_rtk(np.array([20.0, 0.0, 0.0]), "rtk_fixed")101 self.assertLess(float(np.linalg.norm(ekf.p - p_before)), 2.0)102103 def test_rtk_pulls_after_unaided_coast(self):104 g = 9.80665105 ekf = ErrorStateEKF(EkfConfig(gravity=g))106 q = np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0])107 p0 = np.zeros(3)108 ekf.initialize(0.0, p0, q)109 gyro = np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.0])110 accel = np.array([1.0, 0.0, g])111 t = 0.0112 for _ in range(200):113 t += 0.005114 ekf.ingest_imu(t, gyro, accel)115 self.assertGreater(float(np.linalg.norm(ekf.p - p0)), 0.4)116 z = np.array([0.1, -0.05, 0.0])117 err0 = float(np.linalg.norm(ekf.p - z))118 ekf.predict_to(t)119 ekf.update_rtk(z, "rtk_fixed")120 err1 = float(np.linalg.norm(ekf.p - z))121 self.assertLess(err1, err0)122123 def test_short_pose_fd_does_not_slam_velocity(self):124 """8 ms pose Δp/Δt with physics R must not yank v; 0.1 s baseline may."""125 ekf = ErrorStateEKF(EkfConfig())126 q = np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0])127 ekf.initialize(0.0, np.zeros(3), q)128 ekf.v = np.array([0.4, 0.0, 0.0])129 dt_short = 0.008130 v_fd = np.array([0.02 / dt_short, 0.0, 0.0]) # 2.5 m/s from 2 cm jitter131 r_short = 2.0 * (0.1**2) / dt_short**2132 ekf.update_velocity(v_fd, r_var=r_short)133 self.assertLess(abs(float(ekf.v[0]) - 0.4), 0.05)134135 dt_lag = 0.1136 v_lag = np.array([0.5, 0.0, 0.0])137 r_lag = 2.0 * (0.1**2) / dt_lag**2138 ekf.update_velocity(v_lag, r_var=r_lag)139 # Honest 0.1 s R is ~2 (m/s)²; a 0.5 m/s measurement may move v a little.140 self.assertLess(float(abs(ekf.v[0] - 0.4)), 0.2)141142 def test_rtk_does_not_copy_sample_noise(self):143 """5 Hz RTK must not set K≈1 on every sample (pose gap or not)."""144 ekf = ErrorStateEKF(EkfConfig())145 ekf.initialize(0.0, np.zeros(3), np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0]))146 t = 0.0147 for _ in range(10):148 t += 0.2149 ekf.predict_to(t)150 ekf.update_rtk(np.zeros(3), "rtk_fixed")151 xs = []152 noise = [0.0, 0.12, -0.12, 0.12, -0.12, 0.0]153 for n in noise:154 t += 0.2155 ekf.predict_to(t)156 ekf.update_rtk(np.array([n, 0.0, 0.0]), "rtk_fixed")157 xs.append(float(ekf.p[0]))158 self.assertLess(max(xs) - min(xs), 0.20)159160161if __name__ == "__main__":162 unittest.main()163

1"""Unit tests for ENU -> target frame conversion."""23from __future__ import annotations45import unittest67import numpy as np89from orion.frames import T, position_enu_to_target, quat_enu_wxyz_to_target_xyzw, transform_pose10from orion.mathutil import R_to_quat, quat_to_R111213class TestFrames(unittest.TestCase):14 def test_T_involution_and_det(self):15 np.testing.assert_allclose(T @ T, np.eye(3), atol=1e-12)16 self.assertAlmostEqual(float(np.linalg.det(T)), -1.0, places=12)1718 def test_unit_points(self):19 origin = np.zeros(3)20 east = position_enu_to_target(np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0]), origin)21 north = position_enu_to_target(np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0]), origin)22 up = position_enu_to_target(np.array([0.0, 0.0, 1.0]), origin)23 np.testing.assert_allclose(east, [100.0, 0.0, 0.0])24 np.testing.assert_allclose(north, [0.0, 0.0, 100.0])25 np.testing.assert_allclose(up, [0.0, 100.0, 0.0])2627 def test_origin_subtract(self):28 origin = np.array([1.0, 2.0, 3.0])29 p = position_enu_to_target(origin, origin)30 np.testing.assert_allclose(p, [0.0, 0.0, 0.0], atol=1e-12)3132 def test_identity_quat(self):33 q = quat_enu_wxyz_to_target_xyzw(np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0]))34 np.testing.assert_allclose(q, [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0], atol=1e-12)3536 def test_yaw_about_up_stays_yaw_about_up(self):37 yaw90 = np.array(38 [39 [0.0, -1.0, 0.0],40 [1.0, 0.0, 0.0],41 [0.0, 0.0, 1.0],42 ]43 )44 q_enu = R_to_quat(yaw90)45 q_tgt = quat_enu_wxyz_to_target_xyzw(q_enu)46 wxyz = np.array([q_tgt[3], q_tgt[0], q_tgt[1], q_tgt[2]])47 R_tgt = quat_to_R(wxyz)48 x_axis = R_tgt[:, 0]49 self.assertGreater(abs(float(x_axis[2])), 0.9)5051 def test_transform_pose_shape(self):52 p, q = transform_pose(53 np.array([0.1, 0.2, 0.3]),54 np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0]),55 np.zeros(3),56 )57 self.assertEqual(p.shape, (3,))58 self.assertEqual(q.shape, (4,))59 self.assertAlmostEqual(float(np.linalg.norm(q)), 1.0, places=9)606162if __name__ == "__main__":63 unittest.main()64

orion.validate import PoseValidator, TimeValidator1011ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]12DEV_LOG = ROOT / "data" / "orion-dev-log.json"131415def _rec(**kwargs):16 base = {17 "seq": 0,18 self.assertEqual(v.check(_rec(quat_wxyz=[0.1, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0])), "non_unit_quat")59 self.assertEqual(v.check(_rec(confidence=1.5)), "confidence_oob")6061 def test_time_validator(self):62 tv = TestDevLogRejects(unittest.TestCase):70 def test_injected_pose_faults_are_caught(self):71 if not DEV_LOG.exists():72 self.skipTest("dev log missing")73 log = load_log(DEV_LOG)74 v = PoseValidator()75 reasons]83 self.assertTrue(any(r == "future_t_captured" for r in texts), reasons)84 self.assertTrue(85 any(r in ("duplicate_t_source", "duplicate_seq", "non_monotonic_seq") for r in texts),86 1Part 2 - reconstruction range-check23(a) Defect, and how to verify it45The defect that makes the delivered scene the wrong size is metric scale.67The solve claims it is already metric: method estimated_from_rtk_baselines, reported_scale_factor = 1.000. Qualification is stamped qualified = true with gate_version = none and reviewed_by = auto. Splat training’s only input gate is that boolean. The splat was trained and delivered: true.89The same artifact already contains the proof that scale is not 1. Three surveyed RTK baselines vs reconstructed distances:1011 pair b1: 10.63 m reconstructed vs 12.40 m surveyed → ratio 0.8565 (14.4% short)12 pair b2: 6.94 m reconstructed vs 8.10 m surveyed → ratio 0.8568 (14.3% short)13 pair b3: 17.19 m reconstructed vs 20.05 m surveyed → ratio 0.8574 (14.3% short)1415The three ratios agree to about 0.1%. That is a single global scale of ~0.857, not noisy SfM or a warp. The factor that should have been applied is ~1.166. They reported 1.000 anyway.1617So gsplat trained a scene ~14% too small. In an Unreal / AR composite against a surveyed set, objects will not line up.1819How I would verify (no COLMAP rerun):20211. For each RTK baseline pair, compute s_i = reconstructed_m / reference_m.222. Check consistency: max(s_i) / min(s_i) should be ~1. Here it is 1.001 - one scale.233. Check magnitude: mean s ≈ 0.857, not 1.000 ± a few percent.244. Check honesty: reported_scale_factor must match the post-scale table. 1.000 while the table is 14% off is a fail by itself.255. If the camera centres were available: ||C_i − C_j|| vs the survey. Same test, still no solver rerun.2627A second quality problem in the same file: reprojection error is high (median 2.94 px, p95 11.7, max 41.2; mean is not even reported). Inlier ratio 0.61, mean track length 3.1, only 611/812 images registered. That is a dirty solve. Cameras do not agree on where structure is, so a splat will be blurry / doubled. That is not the same defect as scale: a warp would scatter the three baseline ratios, and they do not scatter. High reproj is a reason not to train. The thing that ships a scene of the wrong size is the unapplied RTK scale.2829(b) Qualification gate that should have caught it before training3031Do not train unless every check below passes. Training must require these numbers, not solve.qualification.qualified == true. gate_version == none or reviewed_by == auto must not be allowed to set qualified.3233Gate 1 - range / scale (this is the defect the brief asked for)3435 Let s_i = reconstructed_m / reference_m for each reported RTK baseline pair.36 Require at least 3 pairs (this capture has 6 surveyed points, 3 pairs in the file).37 Fail if any |s_i − 1| > 0.10.38 Fail if max(s_i)/min(s_i) > 1.02 (that would be warp, not a single scale).39 Fail if method is estimated_from_rtk_baselines and reported_scale_factor is 1.000 while the table is not within the tolerances above.4041 On this artifact every pair fails Gate 1 (~14% vs 10%). Training must stop. Example message:4243 "Scale check failed. reported_scale_factor=1.000 but reconstructed/reference = 0.856, 0.857, 0.857 on b1/b2/b3 (need |s-1| ≤ 0.10 and ratios consistent). Do not train."4445Gate 2 - SfM quality (would also have blocked this file)4647 Fail if reprojection_error_px.median > 1.0.48 Fail if reprojection_error_px.p95 > 4.0.49 Fail if inlier_ratio < 0.80.50 Fail if registration_retention < 0.90.5152 On this artifact median reproj is 2.94 px. Example message:5354 "The SfM quality is not good enough. Median reprojection error is 2.94 px, which is greater than 1.0. Do not train."5556This artifact fails Gate 1 and Gate 2. The splat must not have been trained or delivered.57
